title: Inactivity period
loadError: The inactivity period could not be loaded.
intro:
You are entitled to request a break (in months).

During this time you will not take part in the club's activities and will pay a minimum maintenance fee that keeps your place and your current fee for when you return.

It can be requested until day {deadlineDay} of the month before the inactivity period starts.
endNote: You can change your return month during the break. Changes affecting the next month must be requested by day {deadlineDay}.
